manufacturer.name: Merlin
manufacturer.note: Australian garage door opener brand within the Chamberlain group; some of its documents carry Chamberlain's 114A#### numbering. The first research pass recorded that no manufacturer-hosted URL had been found and left supportUrl null rather than guess at merlin.com.au's support path. gomerlin.com.au is now recorded as the site and its support centre as the portal - described as carrying spare parts books, brochures and user guides. Still no direct PDF on a Merlin domain, so every document below remains reseller-hosted.
